name: IGF-1 LR3

lead: IGF-1 LR3 is a lab-modified version of insulin-like growth factor 1 with an extended amino acid chain and an arginine substitution. It was developed for cell culture and sold to bodybuilders as an injectable research chemical.
Animal and cell data show growth effects, but no reliable human trials of benefit in healthy people have been published.

paras: It activates the IGF-1 receptor and downstream PI3K/Akt/mTOR signalling. The modifications lower binding to IGF binding proteins, so it stays active longer than native IGF-1.
Not approved for humans and banned in sport. Main concerns are low blood sugar, fluid retention, joint pain and organ growth, plus theoretical cancer promotion. Products are unregulated.
